title: Europa Universalis V (3450310)
observation: Europa Universalis V (3450310) ffected: experimental-11.0-20260713, hotfix-20260710. Not present in proton-10.0-4. Change Surfaced while playing EU5; 3450310 Proton 10.0 adds gamedrive to compat_config only inside per-appid allowlists (proton lines 1318, 1427, both indented within an if appid in [...]). Proton 11 replaces this with a single unconditional top-level call (Experimental line 1407, Hotfix line 1406): #options to also be enabled for prerequisite setup steps ret.add("gamedrive") Every title now gets dosdevices/s: → <library>/steamapps. Problem z: → / already exposes the entire filesystem, so for any game on a library outside the prefix, the library is now reachable through two drive letters simultaneously. Applications that enumerate paths under the Steam library see every file twice, as two unrelated locations: S:\workshop\content\<appid>\<id> Z:\mnt\Steam\SteamLibrary\steamap
